name: Abang Johari Openg
_note: M2 state-executive cohort: Premier of Sarawak (title renamed from Chief Minister in 2022) since 13 Jan 2017. Added as a GOVERNMENT-aligned (GPS) sub-national executive so the new class spans coalitions (PN opposition premiers plus GPS/GRS government premiers), giving the role-controlled partisan-signal gate a like-with-like comparison. NO coder panel yet, so Layer B is unscored and below ranking validity. Anchor values pending an independent coder panel (minCodersToScore=3). Citations verified via search; full text not opened (fetch restriction); reconfirm against primary sources. The MA63 oil-and-gas scope remains a live constitutional dispute and is framed as unresolved, never a settled Sarawak right. B4 carries no clean personal-candor reversal and is unscored.

metrics.justification: No court matter, MACC charge, or investigation against Abang Johari personally was located; available reporting shows him backing MACC enforcement and tightened state procurement rules rather than as a subject. Recorded as the subject's own status: none on record (an absence-of-evidence finding, not a positive clearance).

citation.title: Abang Jo: Sarawak to tighten procurement rules, boost anti-graft measures with MACC

metrics.justification: Amid January 2025 flooding he announced an additional RM10 million to the State Disaster Management Committee for flood relief (alongside RM25 million in federal aid for Sabah and Sarawak) and signalled a state committee for long-term flood mitigation rather than short-term fixes. Documented relief response with named allocations (anchor 3).

citation.title: Sarawak Premier announces additional RM10mil for flood relief, thanks federal govt for RM25mil aid

metrics.justification: The Free Tertiary Education Scheme, announced on 1 Oct 2023 with a RM250 million first-year allocation covering 64 undergraduate programmes at Sarawak-owned institutions, moved to an operative 2026 start with a stated commitment to continue beyond 2026. A funded reform delivered to operation broadly as promised (anchor 3).

citation.title: Sarawak to offer free higher education by 2026, says Abang Jo

metrics.justification: He built Petroleum Sarawak Berhad (Petros, incorporated 7 Aug 2017) as the state oil-and-gas vehicle, culminating in a Sarawak-Putrajaya joint declaration signed on 21 May 2025 affirming Petros as the sole domestic gas aggregator within a Petros-Petronas cooperation framework, and earlier secured the DUN-voted constitutional renaming of the office to Premier (passed 15 Feb 2022). Documented institution-building through negotiated consensus; the broader MA63 oil-and-gas scope remains a live legal dispute (anchor 4).

citation.title: Anwar, Sarawak premier sign joint declaration on Petronas-Petros cooperation

metrics.justification: His administration runs a standing Unit for Other Religions (Unifor) in the Premier's Department that funds construction, repair and maintenance of non-Muslim houses of worship and mission schools, with a dedicated Unifor Complex opened on 26 Apr 2026 and recurring interfaith programmes. A dated, institutionalised multi-religious inclusive-governance practice (conduct, not belief), uncontested in fact (anchor 3).

citation.title: Sarawak strengthens interfaith unity with opening of Unifor Complex
